label: proxy
scope: Standard global API list price proxy; excludes subscription, infrastructure, tools, Fast mode and regional charges. Tokens are primary.

gpt-6.1-sol.rationale: The exact model has a public API price; identity is the closest public mapping.
gpt-6.1-sol.cache_write_bound: 0 <= unreported cache-write tokens <= input minus cached input; uncached, cached and write categories are disjoint. Unknown context bands span short and long.

supersedes: Version 1 additive conservative envelope; original receipts retained, final reports repriced from counters.
